title: Second Lessons: Ember
introNarration: Cinder taps the Primer. Soot has dried on her whiskers. The grate still holds a low, useful fire. "Cast ember at the hearth dummy in this room. Then talk to me. After that, the book will offer three leaves. Type 1, 2, or 3 when it does."
reminderNarration: Cast ember at the hearth dummy in this hearth, then talk to Cinder. Name the fire before you feed it.
completionNarration: The second hearth lesson is done. The Primer lies open on the grate-side table, smelling of smoke and ink. Type 1, 2, or 3 when it offers three leaves.
